verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports trigger-driven automation through its GitHub integration: automated PR reviews, automated issue triage, and @gemini-cli mentions in issues and PRs for task delegation. It can also run non-interactively in scripts with structured JSON output, which lets users build their own scheduled automation. Community users confirm the GitHub action exists and that its code review is effective. However, there is no documented native scheduler or always-on agent service, and no evidence of autonomous maintenance or fix loops that open fixes without a human prompt. Community reports of agent-mode loops and failures also raise doubts about unattended fixing. Missing for 10: native scheduling/cron triggers, documented always-on agent runtime, evidence of autonomous fix-and-PR workflows, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended remediation.
